title: Namaz for Seeking Allah's help In the name of Lady Fatimah (S)
data:
If you have an urgent request to be granted by Almighty Allah, due to which your heart is distressed, you may offer a two-unit prayer. Upon accomplishment, you may repeat the Takbir statement (Allahu Akbar) three times and then utter the Tasbih al-Zahra. Then you may prostrate yourself and repeat the following supplicatory statement one hundred times:
يا مَوْلَاتِيْ يَا فَاطِمَةُ اَغِيْثِيْنِيْ۔
YAA MAWLAATEE YAA FAATIMATU AGHEESEENEE.
O my Mistress, O Fatimah, help me!
You may then put your right cheek on the ground and repeat the same one hundred times, put your left cheek on the ground and repeat the same one hundred times, and return to the normal position of prostration and repeat the same one hundred and ten times. You may then submit your requests, and Almighty Allah, if He wills, will grant it.
A PRAYER FOR SEEKING GOD'S AID IN THE NAME OF LADY FATIMAH
According to Makarim al-Akhlaq, Shaykh Hasan ibn Fadl al-Tabrisi has said: A prayer for seeking aid from Lady Fatimah (a) - you may offer a two-unit prayer. Upon accomplishment, you may prostrate yourself and repeat the following phrase one hundred times:
يَا فَاطِمَةُ۔
YAA FAATIMAH.
O Fatimah!
You may then put your right cheek on the ground and repeat the same one hundred times, put your left cheek on the ground and repeat the same one hundred times, and return to the normal position of prostration and repeat the same one hundred and ten times. You may then say the following supplicatory prayer:
يَا اٰمِنًا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ مِنْكَ خاۤئِفٌ حَذِرٌ اَسْئَلُكَ بِاَمْنِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَ خَوْفِ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مِنْكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَنْ تُعْطِيَنِيْ اَمَانًا لِنَفْسِيْ وَ اَهْلِيْ وَ مَالِيْ وَ وَلَدِيْ حَتّٰى لَا اَخَافَ اَحَدًا وَّ لَا اَحْذَرَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ اَبَدًا اِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ۔
YAA AAMINAM MIN KULLI SHAY-IW WA KULLU SHAY-IM MINKA KHAAA-IFUN HAZIR, AS-ALUKA BI-AMNIKA MIN KULLI SHAY-IW WA KHAWFI KULLI SHAY-IM MINKA, AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMAD, WA AN TU'TIYANEE AMAANAL LI-NAFSEE WA AHLEE WA MAALEE WA WALADEE, HATTAA LAAA AKHAAFA AHADAW WA LAAA AHZARA MIN SHAY-IN ABADAA, INNAKA A'LAA KULLI SHAY-IN QADEER.
O He Who is secure from everything while everything is fearful and wary of You! I beseech You, by Your security from everything and the fear of everything from You, to bless Muhammad, and to grant me security for myself, my family, my wealth, and my child, so that I never fear anyone nor am ever wary of anything; surely You have power over all things.
